title: Kelcorp's Survival Anarchy Server
description: Survival Anarchy Server [26.1] - A true anarchy experience with no rules, no resets, and no admins interfering. Grief, raid, build, survive, anything goes! Pure vanilla survival now on 26.1! (Supports 1.21.11) The world is yours… if you can survive it.
body:
Survival Anarchy is a Minecraft Survival Server that specifically serves players using the Java edition of the game. The server aims to provide a friendly and welcoming environment for players to enjoy a balanced and engaging Crossplay, Anarchy Survival experience.

Java Server IP: survivalanarchy.mcserver.us:9054
Minecraft Version: The server operates on all Minecraft versions from 26.1 to 1.9 Combat Update (running on a 1.21.11 jar)

It is recommended to use the Simple Voice Chat mod to speak to players in the server
